# 3.0.2 — Zone Authoring Tooling + 3-Zone MVP Scaffold

**Status:** ✅ Done — implemented + verified in-editor 2026-07-04 (ZA1–ZA7).
**Depends on:** 3.0 (zone framework, ✅ verified). **Feeds:** 3.1 (decorate/populate zones).

## Why

3.0 delivered the zone **runtime framework** (additive scenes, interest isolation, server-authoritative
transitions, persisted zone id, zone-aware spawn/chat/AI) and it's verified. But there's no ergonomic way to
**author** zones: portals/entries are generated by a hardcoded `ZoneSetup` (creslins + thornwood only), and
the MVP needs **3 zones** (Creslin's Field → Thornwood → Grukmar's Deep, per `trellis_zone_design.md`), each
large enough for a **~3–5 minute walk** across. This item builds the authoring layer + the 3 flat zone
scaffolds. **Decoration/population is deferred to 3.1** (user: "basic flat terrain… hand-decorate later").

## What already exists (don't rebuild)

- **Portal → destination by string id:** `ZonePortal` carries `targetZoneId` + `targetEntryId`.
- **Landing waypoint:** `ZoneEntry` = an empty GO with a string `entryId`.
- **Arrival facing:** `ZoneManager.ServerMovePlayer` sets arrival yaw from `entry.eulerAngles.y`, and
  `ZoneEntry.OnDrawGizmos` already draws a **forward arrow** — the NWN-style facing flag is fully wired.
- **Portal visibility:** `ZonePortal` spawns a cosmetic cyan pillar at runtime + a radius gizmo in-editor.
- **Navmesh persistence** for scripted zone builds (the `thornwood_navmesh.asset` fix from 3.0.1).

So the model the user sketched *is* the model that exists. The work is ergonomics + content, not new runtime
concepts.

## Decisions

- **ZA1 — Portal/Entry as drag-in prefabs.** Create `Assets/Prefabs/Zones/ZonePortal.prefab` +
  `ZoneWaypoint.prefab` (a `ZoneEntry`) so designers drag them into a zone scene and set ids in the
  Inspector, instead of the tool generating them. *Recommend: yes.*
- **ZA2 — Editor labels on the gizmos.** Small `[CustomEditor]`/`DrawGizmos` additions so a portal shows
  its `→ targetZoneId/targetEntryId` as a `Handles.Label`, and a waypoint shows its `entryId`, floating
  above each in the Scene view (the geometry arrow/sphere already exist). *Recommend: yes — cheap, big
  authoring win.* (Optional stretch: a live warning when a portal's target entry id doesn't exist in the
  catalog's target zone.)
- **ZA3 — Generalized "New Zone" workflow.** Refactor `ZoneSetup`'s hardcoded thornwood builder into a
  reusable `BuildFlatZone(zoneId, sceneName, worldOffset, groundSize)` (flat ground + collider +
  NavMeshSurface baked **and persisted** + a `default` ZoneEntry), and add a `Tools/Zones/New Zone…` window
  (fields: zoneId, sceneName, offset, ground size) that builds it, registers it in `ZoneCatalog`, and adds
  it to Build Settings. *Recommend: yes.* The existing `Build Zone Scenes` becomes "build/refresh the 3 MVP
  zones" on top of `BuildFlatZone`.
- **ZA4 — Zone size + offsets.** Flat ground sized for the walk-time target. At the current `moveSpeed`
  (1 u/s walk), 3–5 min ≈ **180–300 units** across; **default the MVP outdoor zones to ~250–300 units
  square** (user: keep speed as-is, size is the variable). Offsets stay **5000 apart** — creslins `0`,
  thornwood `+5000`, grukmar `+10000` (300 << 5000, so zones never bleed; float-safe out to ~100k).
  *Recommend as stated.* Note banked for later: interest is per-*scene*, so within one zone everyone
  observes everyone (no distance culling) — fine at ~12 players.
- **ZA5 — Support intra-zone portals.** Let a portal land a player at an entry **in the same zone** (future
  needs: dungeon stairs, teleport pads). `ServerMovePlayer` currently early-returns when
  `fromZone == targetZoneId`; change it to, for the same-zone case, **skip the scene move + client scene
  swap but still `ServerWarpTo(entry)`** (+ chat-grid resync + debounce). *Recommend: yes — small change,
  the user asked for it.*
- **ZA6 — 3-zone scaffold + portal graph.** Linear per the trellis design: **Creslin's Field ↔ Thornwood ↔
  Grukmar's Deep.** Upgrade thornwood from the 100×100 stub to full size via `BuildFlatZone`; create
  Grukmar's Deep as a flat zone (dungeon dressing is 3.1). Wire portals + return entries both directions.
  Keep the existing Giant Rat test spawn per zone so isolation stays testable. *Recommend as stated.*
- **ZA7 — Keep everything idempotent + preserve fixes.** `BuildFlatZone` reuses the 3.0.1
  navmesh-persistence step; re-running the tool rebuilds each zone in place. Base scene (creslins) is never
  regenerated (decision A). *Recommend as stated.*

## Scope / files

**New:**
- `Assets/Prefabs/Zones/ZonePortal.prefab`, `Assets/Prefabs/Zones/ZoneWaypoint.prefab` (ZA1).
- `Assets/Scripts/Editor/ZoneMarkerGizmos.cs` — `Handles.Label` for portal target + waypoint id (ZA2).
- `Assets/Scripts/Editor/NewZoneWindow.cs` — the `Tools/Zones/New Zone…` window (ZA3).

**Modified:**
- `Assets/Scripts/Editor/ZoneSetup.cs` — extract `BuildFlatZone(...)`; build thornwood (full size) +
  grukmar; write the 3-zone `ZoneCatalog`; wire the 6 portals/entries of the linear graph; add grukmar to
  Build Settings (ZA3/ZA4/ZA6/ZA7).
- `Assets/Scripts/Networking/Zones/ZoneManager.cs` — `ServerMovePlayer` intra-zone case (ZA5).
- (Maybe) `ZonePortal`/`ZoneEntry` — no field changes expected; gizmo labels live in the editor script.

**No** migration, no schema change (zones are serialized in `ZoneCatalog`, per 3.0 Z1). `characters.zone_id`
already persists (0017); grukmar just becomes a valid value.

## Build / test plan (in-editor, MPPM)

1. Run the New-Zone workflow / `Build Zone Scenes` → 3 zones exist in `ZoneCatalog` + Build Settings, each
   with baked+persisted navmesh, a `default` entry, and the return entries.
2. **Walk the graph:** creslins → thornwood → grukmar and back. Confirm transitions, and that **arrival
   facing** matches each destination entry's arrow (rotate an entry, re-enter, confirm you face that way).
3. **Size feel:** time a walk across a zone — tune `groundSize` to hit 3–5 min.
4. **Isolation across 3 zones** (Server Only + 2–3 MPPM clients): players in different zones don't see each
   other or each other's mobs; per-zone Giant Rat wanders in each.
5. **Persistence:** camp in grukmar → relog → spawn back in grukmar at saved pos (`zone_id` round-trips).
6. **Intra-zone portal:** drop a second entry in one zone + a portal targeting it (same zone) → stepping in
   warps you across the zone with no scene reload.
7. **Authoring ergonomics:** drag the prefabs into a scene, set ids in the Inspector, see the Scene-view
   labels + facing arrow; confirm a hand-placed portal/entry works without the tool.

## Risks

- **Offset vs size:** keep `groundSize` well under the 5000 spacing (documented in `ZoneDefinition`). If a
  zone later needs to be >~2000 units, widen the offset.
- **Large flat navmesh bake:** fine for flat ground; watch bake time only if sizes balloon.
- **Per-scene interest** (no intra-zone culling) — acceptable for MVP; note for M6b load work.

## Implementation log

**2026-07-04 — implemented (code only; pending in-editor verification).**
- **ZA5 (intra-zone portals):** `ZoneManager.ServerMovePlayer` no longer early-returns when
  `fromZone == targetZoneId`; a same-zone target now warps to the entry with **no scene move + no client
  scene swap** (guarded by a `sameZone` flag), so a portal can teleport within a zone.
- **ZA3/ZA4/ZA6/ZA7 (`ZoneSetup.cs` rewritten):** generic `BuildFlatZone(zoneId, sceneName, offset,
  groundSize, decorate)` (flat ground sized off `groundSize`, `BakeAndPersistNavMesh` reusing the 3.0.1
  NavMeshData-save fix, then a `decorate` hook); `Tools/Zones/Build Zone Scenes` now builds all 3 MVP zones
  (thornwood upgraded to `MvpZoneSize = 280u`, **grukmars_deep** created at +10000) and wires the linear
  portal graph (creslins⇄thornwood⇄grukmar with `default`/`from_*` entries + return portals); catalog is
  **upserted** (preserves other zones) and both non-base scenes added to Build Settings. Public
  `CreateZone(...)` backs the New-Zone window. Marker placement is prefab-based (`AddPortal`/`AddEntry`/
  `EnsurePortal`/`EnsureEntry` instantiate the drag-in prefabs); each zone gets a `Giant Rat` `SpawnPoint`
  for isolation testing.
- **ZA1 (prefabs):** `Tools/Zones/Create Zone Prefabs` (auto-run by Build Zone Scenes) creates
  `Assets/Prefabs/Zones/ZonePortal.prefab` + `ZoneWaypoint.prefab` if missing.
- **ZA3 (New-Zone window):** `Assets/Scripts/Editor/NewZoneWindow.cs` → `Tools/Zones/New Zone…` (zoneId /
  sceneName / offset / ground size → `ZoneSetup.CreateZone`).
- **ZA2 (labels):** `Assets/Scripts/Editor/ZoneMarkerGizmos.cs` — `[DrawGizmo]` `Handles.Label`s show a
  portal's `→ zone/entry` and a waypoint's `⚑ entryId` in the Scene view (geometry gizmos already existed).
- No migration/schema (zones live in `ZoneCatalog`; `zone_id` persists since 0017). Verified no dangling
  refs to the old private `ZoneSetup` internals.

**2026-07-04 — VERIFIED in-editor.** User ran `Tools/Zones/Build Zone Scenes` + confirmed the full build/test
plan: 3 zones build with persisted navmesh + prefab-based portal graph, walk creslins→thornwood→grukmar and
back with correct arrival facing, interest isolation across all 3 zones, and camp/relog into the persisted
zone. 3.0.2 closed.

## Done when

Three zones (Creslin's Field, Thornwood, Grukmar's Deep) exist as appropriately-sized flat scaffolds, wired
into a walkable linear portal graph with correct arrival facing, verified for transitions/isolation/
persistence across all three; portals + waypoints are drag-in prefabs with Scene-view labels; a designer can
stamp a new zone via `Tools/Zones/New Zone…` and place portals/entries by hand. Decoration/population is 3.1.
